title: Re-key the API Console storage catalog to `storage` once `@objectstack/spec` publishes the canonical slot
body:
Follow-up to #5286 (framework#9683). `apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts`'s `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG` stays keyed by the deprecated `file-storage` slot name — not re-keyed to the now-canonical `storage` — because the locally pinned `@objectstack/spec` dependency has not published `storage` as a `CoreServiceName` enum member yet:

```
$ node -e "console.log(require('@objectstack/spec/system').CoreServiceName.options)"
[ 'metadata', 'data', 'auth', 'file-storage', 'search', 'cache', 'queue',
  'automation', 'analytics', 'realtime', 'job', 'notification', 'ai', 'i18n', 'ui' ]
```

Re-keying now would fail the `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG keys are canonical service-slot names` tripwire (#4240) against these real, currently-installed types. #5286 instead added a small `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` table that maps the catalog's `file-storage` key to the canonical `services.storage` discovery key to read first, with `file-storage` kept as a fallback.

## Why this needs its own tracking

Nothing forces a revisit once the dependency does bump: `file-storage` stays a valid `CoreServiceName` member for all of v17 (the framework mirrors both keys byte-equal), so every existing test — including the #4240 tripwire — keeps passing unchanged whether or not the catalog gets re-keyed. The alias table would keep working silently forever unless someone remembers to clean it up.

## Suggested resolution (once `@objectstack/spec`'s locally pinned version includes `storage` in `CoreServiceName`)

- Bump the `@objectstack/spec` dependency (this is likely already covered by routine dependency-bump PRs — no action needed beyond noticing `storage` is now available).
- Re-key `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG`'s `'file-storage'` entry to `'storage'`.
- Delete `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` and the special-cased lookup in `useApiDiscovery`'s `discover()`.
- Update `useApiDiscovery.test.ts`'s tripwire block accordingly (the `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG.storage` / `.file-storage` assertions invert).

Not urgent — the current alias-table shape is fully correct and covered by tests; this is cleanup, not a defect. Framework keeps the `file-storage` mirror row for all of v17 either way.
